description: Check whether a domain can be registered and get an indicative price (VAT included where it applies). Read-only: it never buys, registers or reserves a domain. alternatives:true also checks the same name on be, com, net, eu, nl, io, dev and app. Not tied to a site. The result states whether the user's plan includes buying domains in the dashboard (purchase.dashboardUrl); a domain the user already owns is connected with add_custom_domain.

alternatives.description: When true, also check the same second-level name across a canonical TLD set (be, com, net, eu, nl, io, dev, app) and return each one's availability + indicative price.

name: check_domain_availability

alternatives.description: Present only when alternatives:true was requested.

error.description: Set when this TLD lookup failed (e.g. "timeout", "lookup_failed").

priceCents.description: Indicative price in cents (VAT included where it applies), or null if the lookup failed.

unavailableReason.description: Set when the registrar lists the name as free but VibeDeploy cannot register it. MULTI_YEAR_ONLY: this extension is only sold for two years or more, and VibeDeploy registers and renews one year at a time.

available.description: Whether the domain can be registered through VibeDeploy right now.

currency.description: ISO currency code for the price (e.g. EUR).

note.description: Reminder that the price is indicative and nothing was bought.

ownDomain.description: How a domain the user already owns is connected instead.

priceCents.description: Indicative price in cents (VAT included where it applies), or null when no price is published.

purchase.description: Whether and where the user can buy a domain through VibeDeploy.

allowedOnPlan.description: Whether the user's current plan includes buying domains through VibeDeploy.

dashboardUrl.description: Dashboard page where the user buys domains. Buying always happens there, never through this tool.

reason.description: Neutral statement of why buying is not possible. Present only when allowedOnPlan is false.

unavailableReason.description: Set when the registrar lists the name as free but VibeDeploy cannot register it. MULTI_YEAR_ONLY: this extension is only sold for two years or more, and VibeDeploy registers and renews one year at a time.

title: Check domain availability and indicative price
